# Studio workspace router

Screen discovery walks the route tree, skipping disabled subtrees and collecting screen entries. Layouts and redirects remain in the route tree but do not represent screens.

turns.prompt: Repository: studio-workspace-router. Inspect the project in /app read-only. Do not modify or create files, install dependencies, or start services. How many screen entries does registeredScreens() return? Follow the nested route tree and the disabled-subtree rule. Layout and redirect entries are not screens. Return the count.

Repository: studio-workspace-router. Inspect the project in /app read-only. Do not modify or create files, install dependencies, or start services. Within the same enabled screen set you just counted, how many belong to the /workspace subtree, including its index screen and nested board screens? Return the count.
